scope: RecordAddress validates three nonempty string parts and retains the exact encoded key for equality and persistence.
The same domain decoders validate personal records and derive immutable resume, bookmark and history conflict values.
LocalResumeStore projects conflicts in its existing worker path. RecordSync, labels, choice callbacks, alerts, the Sync page and Settings consume typed views.
The journal remains authoritative. Resolving a choice reads current originals and never serializes a UI view.
The reader and conflict labels share tolerant reading-anchor preview parsing. Opaque anchors remain valid when their preview is unavailable.
Conflict equality uses a private detached copy only for comparison, preserving full-content equality and server-copy repair notifications.
